findings.topic: Actual law, finite moments and design
findings.detail: Static generator inspection matches independent standardized Beta(4,4) factors, a shared BMI/glucose component and additive identity-scale HbA1c. Eight fixed 375-row demographic cells yield 3000 rows. Target and Lifelines laws are bounded. Pani age is shifted Gamma with finite polynomial moments and HbA1c is affine in age plus bounded factors; all required cross-moments exist. Independent covariance derivations confirm positive-definite predictor matrices in each declared context.

Independent support arithmetic reproduces BMI [14.2,38.8] kg/m^2, glucose [58.90736241309993,124.69263758690006] mg/dL and target HbA1c [4.075723244029252,7.054276755970749] percent. Task positivity, glucose<126 and integer age/sex quotas hold mathematically without clipping or rejection. These bounded residual restrictions are explicit assumptions. NGSP slope and factor-18 glucose conversions are representation changes, not serum/plasma or assay validation.

Candidate evidence exactly matches all 30 registered source items. The 11 admitted operation IDs exactly match 11 uptake records: three projection constraints and eight compatibility checks. Independent derived coefficients/residual variance and source covariances reproduce two separate Jansen age/sex-adjusted slopes and the Pani fully adjusted age slope. The two Jansen focal slopes are not misused as joint coefficients. Alternate unit representations, shared-cohort overlap and missing source precision are disclosed.

findings.topic: All eight Pani band discrepancies retained
findings.detail: Independent integer-Gamma survival/first-moment finite sums reproduce all eight conditional age/HbA1c means and their discrepancies. Every calculated mean exceeds the reported mean; raw differences range from 0.15000684640365503 to 0.3505737704918026 percentage points. The source >=70 band remains unbounded, and all band probabilities sum to one. The candidate explicitly records compatibility status fail. Reported survey SE stays estimator uncertainty and is not converted to residual SD, a tolerance, or a pooled loss. This disclosed scientific conflict does not block artifact/probability-law readiness.

Inspected analytic/source_algebra.py and the admitted pure source_projection helper. Calculations derive moments from affine factor equations, solve separately defined projections and evaluate finite Gamma sums. Independent review used its own algebra, without importing either author code or helper. Lifecycle and semantic preflight passed, with source/freeze/analytic/input/semantic hashes checked and all 29 target-table source comparisons unavailable. No exploratory feedback is required or claimed; no target results, generated rows, generator execution or cache changes were used.

Q1 and Q2 reproduce transported source anchors only under the declared conditional-law assumptions; Q3 and Q2-Q3 depend on rho=0.25 and unreported covariate independence. Source age shapes, source analysis-set equivalence, zero sex effect, selection, survey interpretation and cross-population/measurement transport remain unvalidated. In particular the common Lifelines/Pani level-age curve does not reproduce all evidence. External-estimate, structural and transport uncertainty remain unquantified; readiness is not favorable fit or clinical validity.
